evidence.text: SCHEME NAME: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC students
SCHEME CATEGORY / TYPE: Education & Learning

implementing_authority.value: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

evidence.text: IMPLEMENTING AUTHORITY: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

target_beneficiaries.value: SC students from economically weaker families at the post-matriculation or post-secondary level

evidence.text: The objective of the scheme is to increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher education by providing financial assistance to students from economically weaker families at the post-matriculation or post-secondary level
providing financial assistance to students from economically weaker families at the post-matriculation or post-secondary level

age_criteria.value: The ceiling on age limit for admission as a regular student in different classes should be decided by the concerned institutions.

evidence.text: The ceiling on age limit for admission as a regular student in different classes should be decided by the concerned institutions.

income_criteria.value: Parents' or guardians' income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/- per annum.

evidence.text: Scholarships will be paid to students whose parents' or guardians' income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/- per annum.

academic_criteria.value: Passed the Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education

evidence.text: Only candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes and have passed the Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education are eligible.
Only candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes and have passed the Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education are eligible.

domicile_criteria.value: Indian nationals only, selected by the State Government/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs (permanently settled or domiciled)

evidence.text: The scholarships are open to Indian nationals only.
the awardees are selected by the State Government/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs (i.e. the State/UT in which permanently settled or domiciled)
providing financial assistance to students from economically weaker families at the post-matriculation or post-secondary level

value: Group-1 Degree and post Graduate Level professional courses: Hostellers ₹ 13,000/- yearly, Day Scholars ₹ 7,000/- yearly
Group-2 Other Professional Courses leading to Degree, Diploma, Certificate: Hostellers ₹ 9,500/- yearly, Day Scholars ₹ 6,500/- yearly
Group-3 Graduate and Post Graduate courses not covered under group 1 & group II: Hostellers ₹ 6,000/- yearly, Day Scholars ₹ 3,000/- yearly
Group-4 All post matriculation (Post Class X level non-degree courses: Hostellers ₹ 4,000/- yearly, Day Scholars ₹ 2,500/- yearly
Ten percent extra allowances shall be provided for Divyang students.
